async def run(items, step):
    await in_order(items, step, reason=ORDER_REASON)
class Runner:
    async def run(self, items, step):
        await in_order_steps([step], reason=ORDER_REASON)
    async def shadow(self, items, step, ORDER_REASON):
        # ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-python
        await in_order(items, step, reason=ORDER_REASON)
ORDER_REASON: str = 'Each update reads the previous write'
async def short(items, step):
    # ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-python
    await in_order(items, step, reason=SHORT_REASON)
SHORT_REASON = 'too short'
